name: Whitestone
author: Aziel Eliab
one_line: Ephemeral pro se family-law advisor. Open the live Worker URL on a phone or desktop — no zip or App Store download. Session-only memory; wipe on close. Uploads only, no case exports, no third-party LLM APIs. Hosted app may fetch allowlisted public court/legal-aid pages for the session only.
coverage: High-level procedural overview and checklists for custody, parenting time, child support, spousal support, divorce, legal separation, parentage, guardianship, family protection orders, adoption overview, and name change — all 50 U.S. states and D.C. Not an annotated code.
disclaimer: Educational procedural guidance only. Not a lawyer. Not legal advice. Verify with the court clerk and counsel.
